info.title: Dopp API
info.description: Drop-in proxy for Jev-compatible decision APIs. Same request and reply as POST /v1/systemone; every request is kept and can train a model for its route. Docs: http://localhost:8787/docs.md

post.summary: Answer typed questions about a state
post.description: Identical to TypeSafe's /v1/systemone. Bearer: a Dopp route key (us_…) made in this server's dashboard; nothing else is accepted. Optional header x-jev-key forwards the caller's own TypeSafe key for that request only (never stored).

model.description: jev-latest (default) or an upstream id from the account's catalog

state.description: the text or JSON to decide about

200.description: answers per question with probabilities; understudy.served says who answered

402.description: a guest account's allowance is spent

429.description: over 120 requests a minute on one key
